thread:
maria_cs: FYI — TidalEdge running an APAC pilot demo tomorrow 09:00 SGT. Staging is throttling their scripts, they9re asking for a temporary throughput uplift + CIDR grant for 48-72h. Renewal touchpoint in ~13 days so this demo matters.

jack_infra: Can you paste the CIDRs and exact window? Region preference? Need to know model slug too so I can pin capacity.

maria_cs: Owner is sara@tidaledge.com. They gave 2036-11-11/12 example earlier but updated: window 2026-03-25T02:00Z -> 2026-03-27T02:00Z (48h) — they9re asking conservatively for 48h first. Peak bursts up to ~2200 qps, steady ~1200. CIDRs: 34.75.12.0/24 and 13.250.128.0/17. Prefer asia-southeast-1. Model: tidal-demo-1 -> redwood/gpt-medium-v1-staging. They also want prefix caching and a short warmup.

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-6275 created by @jack_infra: "TidalEdge APAC demo temporary burst + CIDR grant". Approval SLA 2h. https://redwood.ops/OPS-6275

jack_infra: Thanks. I'll reserve a burst pool and add those CIDRs to the proxy allowlist. Sophie: can you pre-warm KV and bump concurrency? Also reduce batch_max_tokens to 256 for consistency with demo scripts.

sophie_se: Will do. Plan: pre-warm top-10 prompt prefixes, set concurrency=20, batch_max_tokens=256, enable prefix caching TTL=600s. I9ll also create a canary route with warmed variant and run a smoke harness.

maria_cs: cc @aaron_ae please — surface any cost uplift in renewal notes. If demo fails, renewal will be at risk.

aaron_ae: Noted. If we see success, push as a renewal win. If we need extension, I'll loop legal for contract note.

jack_infra: Small hiccup: initial canary deploy failed with OOM on one warm pod (see logs). Increasing instance size for that canary and re-trying.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment attempt failed: OOMKilled on instance i-0a1b2c3d. Retrying with larger instance size.

jack_infra: Retry successful. Canary warmed OK; kv_cache_hits ~95% on warm runs. OPS-6275 updated with cost estimate ~$950 for 48h burst.

maria_cs: Great. Please set auto-revoke at 2026-03-27T02:10Z and notify me. I'll confirm with Sara after her 08:30 SGT smoke test.

ops-bot: OPS-6275 status: Provisioned. CIDRs 34.75.12.0/24, 13.250.128.0/17 added to proxy allowlist. Burst pool allocated in asia-southeast-1. Auto-revoke scheduled 2026-03-27T02:10Z.

jack_infra: All set. Note: we limited burst to demo model slug to avoid broad exposure. Documented rollback steps in OPS ticket.

maria_cs: Confirmed with customer: smoke passed, full demo ran at 09:00 SGT. Sara sent screenshot of demo flow. AE @aaron_ae capturing in renewal notes.

jack_infra: Closing OPS-6275 as completed; will trigger revoke at scheduled time. Reach out if they request extension.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. Marking as a positive renewal signal. :party_popper:
